reviewer: identity_integration_audit; AI-assisted visual review, not external human ground truth
blinding: All20 original pretrim SAM outputs reviewed from neutral proposal/context sheets before reading selection decisions, publisher boxes, biological label counts or another reviewer verdict. The scene and some earlier initial masks were seen during prior research, so this is independently ordered geometry review, not previously unseen-source blinding. Region labels are spatial descriptions, not biological identities.
policy: mostly_complete means a coherent single visible animal at this image quality, not pixel-exact segmentation or certified whole biological body. Partial masks can still contain useful coat texture. frame_truncated preserves a genuine edge animal without inventing invisible extent. No acceptance threshold, labels or original masks are changed.
